Mount Lady.name: Mount Lady
Mount Lady.basicInfo:
Mount Lady (Yu Takeyama, Mt. Lady for short), a rookie pro who grows into a giant, famous since her debut the spring before the entrance exam, when she kicked down a rampaging villain on camera and introduced herself. Long wavy blonde hair, violet eyes, an average build; a purple-and-cream costume and a horned purple domino mask.
Speaking Style: Bright, breezy, self-promoting; poses for any camera and needles Kamui Woods; short urgent orders in a crisis.
Combat Role: Giant-form capture: kicks, grabs and pins; narrow streets and crowds keep her small.
Under Pressure: Takes the rescue over the shot, then hopes someone filmed it.
Mount Lady.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: She steals captures on camera, yet in a disaster she stands between it and the crowd without checking the angle. Motivation: A top ranking, sponsors and her face everywhere; underneath, the wish to deserve them. Concealment: Fear of being a novelty act; at the sludge villain attack the spring before the entrance exam the street was too narrow for her to grow. Connections: Kamui Woods, whose capture she took at her debut; they share an agency block and trade jabs in public. Knowledge: Endorsements, rankings, and which streets are wide enough for her. Canon voice & behavior: Arrives with a giant kick and a pose; under real threat she says little and holds on. Thread: Whether chasing the spotlight costs someone before she earns it.
QUIRK: Gigantification. Ordinary height or one giant size, about twenty meters, nothing between; her costume grows too. Giant, she is clumsy and the biggest target around.
personality: Camera-ready: Finds the press angle at any incident and poses for it, even mid-capture.
Scene-stealer: Grabs captures other heroes set up and calls it teamwork.
Brave underneath: Shields civilians without hesitating, then looks for the photographer.
Speaking style: Bright, breezy self-promotion and teasing; short, direct orders in a rescue.
abilities: Gigantification: Grows to her one giant size in moments; she needs open ground and cannot pick a smaller size.
Canyon Cannon: Her debut move, a running start that grows into a giant flying kick; it needs a long runway.
Big rescue: Catches debris, blocks a road or lifts a vehicle clear; fine work at that size is clumsy.
Media sense: Knows where every camera is and gives the line that airs; she overplays it.
Fighting style: Kicks first, then pins the target for capture; at ordinary size she has only a rookie's training.
Mount Lady.visualDescription: A young woman with long, wavy blonde hair, violet eyes, fair skin and an average build. She wears her hero costume: a purple outfit with cream panels, pale gloves and boots, and a purple domino mask with two pale, pointed horn-like tips rising above the eyes. Bright, confident expression with a showy, camera-ready smile.
